resources.string: Choose which apps use this VPN profile

Only selected apps use this VPN, subject to the profile and gateway routes. Other apps use the default network. The VPN service is always included for its existing keepalive. Lists show apps with launcher entries in this Android user. Saving active rules briefly disconnects and reconnects; authentication may be required. Android’s “Block connections without VPN” can prevent direct access for other apps.
